Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)

Current:  2.45%
90d low:  1.91%
Move:     +54bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real (TIPS) yield jumped to 2.45% on 2026-09-02, up 0.54pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.91%.

内容:
10 年期实际(TIPS)收益率在 2026-09-02 升至 2.45%，较过去 90 天低点 1.91% 上升 0.54 个百分点。

Why it matters:
A rising real yield tightens financial conditions and raises the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex bets, directly pressuring the valuations that depend on cheap long-term financing. C10 mirrors C7's escalation logic — this crossing 2x the trigger moves the signal from MED to HIGH.

影响:
实际收益率上升会收紧金融环境，抬高长久期 AI capex 押注适用的贴现率，直接压制依赖低成本长期融资的估值。C10 沿用 C7 的升级逻辑，这次涨幅达到触发阈值的 2 倍，信号从 MED 升到 HIGH。

alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.44% (+55bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-09-01
Current:  2.44%
90d low:  1.89%
Move:     +55bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real (TIPS) yield rose to 2.44 from a trailing-90-day low of 1.89, a 0.55pp climb, as of 2026-09-01.

内容:
10 年期实际利率（TIPS 收益率）从过去 90 天低点 1.89 升至 2.44，涨了 0.55 个百分点，截至 2026-09-01。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields tighten financial conditions and raise the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex cash flows, directly pressuring the valuations that depend on those future payoffs. C10 mirrors C7's structure — this crossing the 2x-trigger threshold escalates it from MED to HIGH.

影响:
实际利率上升会收紧金融条件，也会提高 AI capex 那些长久期未来现金流的贴现率，直接压低依赖这些回报的估值。C10 结构和 C7 一致，这次涨幅越过 2 倍触发阈值，级别从 MED 升到 HIGH。
